last.verdict: Search traffic is collapsing and Reddit warned of fewer users ahead, outweighing strong profits.

reasons.label: Warning of user drop
reasons.text: Reddit said daily users could fall by a low-double-digit percentage in Q4 if trends hold.

reasons.label: Google traffic keeps shrinking
reasons.text: Search referrals fell "meaningfully," worsened late in Q3, and dropped over 1 million a week in October.

reasons.label: U.S. users shrinking
reasons.text: U.S. daily users fell 2% from a year ago; revenue growth slowed to 53%.

story: Revenue growth has slowed from 61% last quarter to 53%, while search-traffic worries have grown from "choppy" in July to a flagged user decline. Strong profits haven't offset this; the stock fell 21% after the last report and 29% now.

history.verdict: Strong quarter, but weaker user and search-traffic signs sent investors selling hard.

reasons.label: Search traffic wobbling
reasons.text: CEO called Google search referrals "choppy," more volatile late in the quarter; no new licensing deals.

reasons.label: U.S. users slipped
reasons.text: U.S. daily users reportedly dipped from the prior quarter; only 6% year-over-year growth.

reasons.label: Sky-high expectations
reasons.text: Revenue grew 61% to $805M, but the stock had run up and priced in more.
